Odesyus' Landing is a small outpost on the southern coast of Azuremyst Isle in Kalimdor, founded by an Alliance fleet led by Admiral Odesyus. Admiral Odesyus was forced to port on Azuremyst Isle after the fleet's :Nautical Compass and :Nautical Map were stolen by the Venture Co. It is little more than a campfire with a two story log wall around one side of it. The cook "Cookie" McWeaksauce provides the food for this outpost. Two ships of Odesyus' fleet are moored near the outpost.
__NOTOC__ Obsidion is a golem found along with Lathoric the Black deep in the Slag Pit in the Searing Gorge.
Oculus Illusions requires you to collect eyes from the dragonkin in Upper Blackrock Spire for Myranda the Hag.
Ogg'marr is an ogre meat and drink vendor located in Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

Offensive Towering is an RTS strategy when someone uses a tower offensively rather than defensively. Offensive Towering is usually used at opponents bases, effectively walling them in and stopping them from doing anything. Offensive Towering is rarely used to finish off the opponent and is usually employed in order to weaken or slow down the opponent's units.
Ockil is a draenei artisan engineering trainer located at the Trader's Tier in the Exodar. During the Battle for the Exodar, he was inside Velen's protective shield.
Officer Khaluun was a draenei quest giver located in the Seat of the Naaru in the Exodar.
Obsidian Warbeads are worn by the Ogres of Nagrand. Various factions with a presence in Nagrand collect the warbeads and are willing to reward any adventurers who gather them.
An officer is a member of any armed force who holds a position of authority.
Ogir is a Broken reagents & poison vendor located at Telaar in Nagrand.

The Offering of the Sha'tar was a quest reward from Battle of the Crimson Watch. It contained one of two Illidari trophy tabards (green or purple) as a gift from A'dal for defeating a number of Illidan's elite troops. At some point the quest was updated to give both tabards directly instead.
Ogoun, the Loa of war, teaches the shadow hunter to place dire curses upon his enemies, a hex.

Oglethorpe's Homing Robots is not so much a chain of quests, as a series of prerequisites enabling a concluding quest. In each of 3 zones, an OOX homing robot (which looks like a robotic chicken) has been lost and needs rescuing. By hunting in each of these zones (for Tanaris, also in Zul'Farrak), you will eventually run across the corresponding homing beacon. The easiest way to obtain the drop for the Tanaris escort quest is by doing Zul'Farrak, however, if the object drops only one person can have it, so make sure you tell your group you need it before you enter the instance. An off spec (often abbreviated to OS) refers to a role a player able (or willing) to play while not being specifically geared towards it. It is distinguished from main spec and can be created through dual spec. The term "off spec" is not to be confused with off tanking or off healing, situations where the player is only intended to intermittently supplement the role of another player already in the group. Rather than re-spec, some players carry multiple sets of equipments for these alternate roles. Players who off-spec frequently tend to purchase dual specs; in that case the "offspec" may be the one played less frequently or the one lacking gear as high quality as the usual spec. Players wil

Of the Exodar is a title awarded to Alliance players upon completing Exalted Champion of the Exodar, which requires the player attain status with the Exodar and earn the right to represent the Exodar in the Argent Tournament. Draenei characters can obtain this title by completing The Valiant's Challenge (Alliance). Characters of other Alliance races must complete their version of The Valiant's Challenge, then complete A Valiant Of The Exodar.

Of Darnassus is a title awarded to Alliance players upon completing Exalted Champion of Darnassus, which requires the player attain status with Darnassus and earn the right to represent Darnassus in the Argent Tournament. Night elf characters can obtain this title by completing The Valiant's Challenge (Alliance). Characters of other Alliance races must complete their version of The Valiant's Challenge, then complete A Valiant Of Darnassus.

Of Gnomeregan is a title awarded to Alliance players upon completing Exalted Champion of Gnomeregan, which requires the player attain status with Gnomeregan and earn the right to represent Gnomeregan in the Argent Tournament. Gnome characters can obtain this title by completing The Valiant's Challenge (Alliance). Characters of other Alliance races must complete their version of The Valiant's Challenge, then complete A Valiant Of Gnomeregan.

Of Ironforge is a title awarded to Alliance players upon completing Exalted Champion of Ironforge, which requires the player attain status with Ironforge and earn the right to represent Ironforge in the Argent Tournament. Dwarf characters can obtain this title by completing The Valiant's Challenge (Alliance). Characters of other Alliance races must complete their version of The Valiant's Challenge, then complete A Valiant Of Ironforge.

Of Stormwind is a title awarded to Alliance players upon completing Exalted Champion of Stormwind, which requires the player attain status with Stormwind and earn the right to represent Stormwind in the Argent Tournament. Human characters can obtain this title by completing The Valiant's Challenge (Alliance). Characters of other Alliance races must complete their version of The Valiant's Challenge, then complete A Valiant Of Stormwind.

Of Orgrimmar is a title awarded to Horde players upon completing Exalted Champion of Orgrimmar, which requires the player attain status with Orgrimmar and earn the right to represent Orgrimmar in the Argent Tournament. Orc characters can obtain this title by completing The Valiant's Challenge (Horde). Characters of other Horde races must complete their version of The Valiant's Challenge, then complete A Valiant of Orgrimmar.

Of Sen'jin is a title awarded to Horde players upon completing Exalted Champion of Sen'jin, which requires the player attain status with the Darkspear tribe and earn the right to represent Sen'jin in the Argent Tournament. Troll characters can obtain this title by completing The Valiant's Challenge (Horde). Characters of other Horde races must complete their version of The Valiant's Challenge, then complete A Valiant of Sen'jin.

Of Thunder Bluff is a title awarded to Horde players upon completing Exalted Champion of Thunder Bluff, which requires the player attain status with Thunder Bluff and earn the right to represent Thunder Bluff in the Argent Tournament. Tauren characters can obtain this title by completing The Valiant's Challenge (Horde). Characters of other Horde races must complete their version of The Valiant's Challenge, then complete A Valiant of Thunder Bluff.

Odd Crystals are located in the Vision of Orgrimmar and the Vision of Stormwind. These crystals are typically hidden out of sight. They may be found inside buildings or behind stacks of crates. The more crystals the adventurer finds, before dealing with him, the better the reward will be when the Reclaimed Spoils Stash is looted. There are two crystals hidden in each wing of the visions, for a total of ten crystals per run.

The term oil refers to a variety of liquid substance items used for different purposes. Certain types of oil are used as ingredients for alchemy recipes, as potions, or applied by enchanters to provide buffs. Other types of oil are used as resources, particularly in Warcraft II and Warlords of Draenor.

__NOTOC__ Oily Blackmouth is obtained by fishing and is a component in Blackmouth Oil (made with Alchemy). Fishing for Oily Blackmouth requires (third tier) fishing skill-level of 55 (or 150 to ensure a catch). Oily Blackmouth can be fished straight from the water or also from an Oily Blackmouth School.
__NOTOC__ Oil of Immolation is an expendable item that does a small amount of fire damage to enemies in a small radius for a limited time.

Okril'lon Hold, previously called Dreadmaul Hold, was a Horde fortress in the northwest corner of the Blasted Lands. It was originally called Rockard, but was later renamed by the Dreadmaul ogres who took control of it. It contains a barracks and a blacksmith. During the Ironmarch invasion the hold was captured by the Iron Horde and served as their headquarters for the invasion. The Horde and the Alliance eventually killed its leader.

__NOTOC__ Ol' Sooty is a black bear that lives in Grizzlepaw Ridge of Loch Modan. He is frequently the target of unsuccessful hunters out of Farstrider Lodge. He used to be seen in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

Ogre lords refer to both a rank of ogre leaders as well as a rare race believed to be a missing link between ogres and their larger relatives.

Ok'thor the Breaker is an elite ogre mage that sometimes appears in Blackrock Depths. When a player enters the Ring of Law in the Depths, an arena event will occur where players have to face three waves of non-elite enemies and finally an elite mini-boss. Ok'thor is one of six possible mini-bosses that could appear. The other ones are Anub'shiah, Eviscerator, Grizzle, Hedrum the Creeper, and Gorosh the Dervish.
Oil of Olaf drops from Olaf in Uldaman. This item is a quest reward from Shipment to Stormwind.

Ogron is an ogre quest giver located southeast of Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

Ohgan is a raptor boss in Zul'Gurub that accompanied Bloodlord Mandokir. Mandokir starts out mounted on Ohgan, but he dismounts during the encounter. When Ohgan is killed, Mandokir's damage increases. As a result, strategies for the encounter may vary. Some suggested killing Ohgan first and healing through Mandokir's increased damage. Others suggest offtanking Ohgan throughout the fight and killing Ohgan after Mandokir.
Ogremind Ring drops from Boulderfist Shaman and Boulderfist Magus in Arathi Highlands. The ring can also be looted from Crate of Salvage and Big Crate of Salvage.
Ogreseer Tower Boots are a pair of Level 55 quality Cloth Boots that improve Intellect, Stamina and Critical Strike.
__NOTOC__ Okrek is a rare mob arakkoa found in Terokkar Forest.

The Ogri'la Care Package contains various consumables. It includes 3 Red Ogre Brew Special, 2 Blue Ogre Brew Special, and one of the following: Unstable Flask of the Bandit, Unstable Flask of the Elder, Unstable Flask of the Physician, or Unstable Flask of the Soldier.
The Ogri'la Tabard is an tabard. It is a reward for your hard work and honor among the Ogri'la faction.
Ogre Defiler's Handguards are quest reward from A Curse Upon Both of Your Clans!.

Okuno is a Broken of the Ashtongue Deathsworn and their faction rewards vendor who can be found in the Black Temple. When the Burning Legion returned, Okuno was taken out by the Illidari in order to infiltrate the Black Temple.
Ohlorn Farstrider is a tauren found in Garadar at Nagrand. He and Steven Walker used to hunt with only his totem and skivvies.
Oil-stained Cloak is a quest reward from Operation Recombobulation (Classic).
The Oiled Leather Leggings are a quest reward from Catch a Dragon by the Tail.

Oil Spills are fishing pools found in various in-land lakes such as around Blackwolf River and Cragpool Lake They usually contain Oil Covered Fish and Firefin Snapper, although they can hold other goodies normally associated with fishing pools.
The Ogre Remains can be found throughout Stonemaul Ruins in Dustwallow Marsh.

Prior to 2010, Ohanzee was found in Eck's cave, which is accessible only in the Heroic version of Gundrak. However, Ohanzee now stands behind the Drakkari Colossus, making him accessible in both the Heroic and Normal versions of the instance.
Oh Novos! is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Novos the Summoner in Drak'Tharon Keep on Heroic difficulty without any undead minions to reach the floor.
Oily Blackmouth School are found in the coastal waters of Arathi Highlands, Desolace, and Dustwallow Marsh. Also, they can be found just north of Grom'Gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn.

The Ogre Legion was some form of ogre faction in Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos. Ogres are referred to as part of this Legion in their tooltips, visible when hiring them from Mercenary Camps and in the World Editor.

Okril'lon Defenders are orcs that guard Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands. They are likely named after the Hold's Warmatron, Okrilla.
Ogre Henchmen are ogres located within the first section of the Deadmines, sometimes using the candles atop Kobold Diggers' heads to light their cannons.

Okrut Dragonwaste is a master Pet Tamer located at the southern tip of the Path of the Titans in the Dragonblight. A crew of Dragonwaste Enslavers, who have captured a Subjugated Drake, work under his command nearby. He is surrounded by his three level 25 battle pets: Rot, Sleet, and Drogar. He acts in the name of Warchief Garrosh Hellscream. Defeating him is required to complete the Taming Northrend achievement.
Ohganot So Fast! is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Bloodlord Mandokir in Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty without killing Ohgan.
Oily Gloves are one of the random vendor trash drops from the Blingtron 4000 Gift Package.
Oku-Oku is a level 90 hozen gladiator found in the Unga Ingoo scenario. Oku-Oku and Gagoon attack when Brewmaster Bo approaches them.
Ogre Toe Ring can be looted from the three Bladespire Brutes that are found in the time-locked Mor'dul Tower in southwestern Frostfire Ridge.
Ogre Mask M was never made available. The visuals were instead used for the Ogre Male Mask.
Ogre Mask F was never made available. The visuals were instead used for the Ogre Female Mask.
__NOTOC__ Ogzor the Necrothurge is an orc located at the Icescar Boneyard in Frostfire Ridge. He has several Eyes of Ogzor and Ogzor's Bones minions.
Ogzor's Bones are skeleton spellcasters found at the Icescar Boneyard in Frostfire Ridge where they aid their warlock master, Ogzor the Necrothurge.
Ogron Warcrushers are ogron located in the Blackrock Quarry in Tanaan Jungle.
Ogron Destructors are ogron found in Brute's Rise in Ashran. They are encountered at the top of the steps which separate sections of the base, hurling boulders down at oncomers.

The chest of Ogron Plunder is found at next to a campfire guarded by Toom, Bort, and Wullim east of Bloodmane Valley in southeastern Spires of Arak. Opening the chest while Toom is still alive will cause the ogron to yell: : Dispatch the ogron (consider doing so before looting the chest, as they're not linked) to acquire the Burglar's Vest and 12 Dwarf Beard Rings.
Ogre Missives are an uncommon find when surveying archaeology sites. This item will also drop from the Ancient Ogres that will sometime spawn when digging for fragments.
The Ogre Diving Cap is a common quality 20 slot bag contained in Watertight Bag in .
Ogre Magi are ogre mage creeps that can be encountered in the Lordaeron Summer, Fall and Winter tilesets. They are the spellcasting warriors of the Ogre Legion.
Ogre Waystones are charged stones used for the opening of Ogre Waygates. 25 of these stones can be collected to activate the gates.

These gargantuan ships of war are the main armament in the dark armada of the Horde. Heavily armed and armored, the Juggernaughts are veritable floating fortresses that constitute the greatest implement of destruction within the Horde's naval forces. While not as swift as the Troll warships, these ruinous craft have quickly come to be feared across the seas of Azeroth for the unrelenting onslaught they render against the Alliance.
Ogre Observer is a professions achievement requiring the discovery of all Ogre archaeology relics.
